title: First brass band job for a carnival club
summary: Borrowed militia uniforms for a ten-piece brass band in the Garden District carnival parade; they plan to find the clipping.

bands.name: Garden District Carnival Club brass band

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Parading for Mardi Gras and the clubs

blocks.x: How old were you for that parade then?
Oh I guess around 15 or 16 years.
Well we could find that in the paper in the library. We'll do that.
I was thinking about looking. I wanted Tom to go down with me. And I could look over the paper in that particular year.
We'll look it up. We'll find it. It might take a while but we'll do it.
